comparison: Perfect agreement on claims C9-C14 regarding peak cluster identification. Both evaluate as SUPPORTED. OpenEval emphasizes internal consistency of quantitative data and methodology, while peer reviewer praises the 'very compelling' peak cluster extraction pipeline and cross-species registration.

Partial disagreement on claims C15-C20, C52-C53 regarding distribution patterns. OpenEval rates SUPPORTED with strong quantitative evidence, but peer reviewer rates UNCERTAIN, noting initial lack of 'systematic comparison' that required revision to address. Peer concerns were eventually resolved but suggest initial evidence presentation was insufficient.

Agreement on claims C21-C22, C43 regarding consistency patterns. Both evaluate as SUPPORTED after revision. OpenEval notes appropriate statistical rigor while acknowledging weak correlation in C43. Peer reviewer initially raised concerns about missing multiple comparison correction and t-values, which were addressed in revision.

Agreement on claims C24-C26 regarding anatomical correlations. Both evaluate as SUPPORTED. OpenEval emphasizes statistical significance and appropriate handling of exceptions. Peer reviewer initially requested multiple comparison correction and t-values, which were added in revision to achieve 'solid support.'

Agreement on claims C27, C49 regarding connectivity and hub properties. Both evaluate as SUPPORTED. OpenEval notes appropriate statistical tests and reasonable hub interpretation. Peer reviewer initially raised statistical concerns that were 'convincingly addressed' in revision.

Partial overlap on claims C28, C59-C60 (both address these), but peer R6 also covers C61, C71-C72 which OpenEval addresses separately in R13. Both evaluate as SUPPORTED for the overlapping claims. OpenEval acknowledges resolution-dependency as methodological artifact; peer reviewer's statistical concerns were resolved in revision.

Agreement on claims C29-C30, C74-C75 regarding gene expression analysis. Both evaluate as SUPPORTED. OpenEval notes appropriate statistical methods but questions functional interpretations. Peer reviewer initially criticized incomplete reporting of gene selection procedure and missing gene list, which were addressed in revision.
